Package org.unitseek.knitid.core.api

Class IdContext

java.lang.Object
org.unitseek.knitid.core.api.IdContext
public final class IdContext extends Object
Immutable per-call context.

Fields are optional. Generators that do not use a field ignore it. businessDateTime() takes precedence over businessDate() when both are set.

Since:
1.0.0
